lines.text: Many learners say: Because it rained, so I stayed home.
Better: Because it rained, I stayed home.
No word! Because I was tired, I went home.

data.wrong: Because it rained, so I stayed home.
data.right: Because it rained, I stayed home.

quiz.stem: Because I was tired, ___ I went home.

native.hook: because 和 so 不能同时用！
native.tip: 中文常说“因为下雨，所以我留在家里”，两个词一起用。英语里 because 和 so 只能留一个。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “Because it rained, so I stayed home.”😅 中文“因为……所以……”连用，英语只留一个：“Because it rained, I stayed home.”跟着 Carlos 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“Because it rained, I stayed home.”大声读一遍，再写一句你自己的句子。免费测验在这里：{link}

en.hook: because and so cannot be used at t
en.tip: Chinese often uses both words, but English uses only one of them.
en.caption: Do you say “Because it rained, so I stayed home.” 😅 English uses only one of them: “Because it rained, I stayed home.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
